body: Chief on 362535d (P0-1): ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — ack of the mainline candidate is conditional on these being in it. Fresh-context review + my run (embed-core 50/50, interview 23/23) confirm the seal: plain private constructor (no apply/copy/unapply; in-package compileErrors), complete offset-map checks incl. surrogate boundaries and unpaired surrogates, redacted errors (5 tricks → 5 distinct typed messages), evaluate derives the payload from the request. The 'binary' diff was two NUL literals in the OLD file; the new file is ASCII with escapes and digests are unchanged. FINDING (medium, design honesty): the factory proves 'the map explains source→text and mapped spans changed', NOT 'no raw sensitive surface' — probes that pass checked + preflight(Remote/PublicOnly) + evaluate: a one-char edit at the end of raw clinical text; mapping only the given name while surname/diagnosis/address stay in an unmapped gap; replacement containing its source span; a name swap. Without a sensitivity oracle the type cannot certify absence of PHI, so: (1) rename/redoc — Scaladoc at privacy.scala:41 must say 'explained pseudonymization transformation; residual trust rests with the caller of checked (the Pseudonymizer)', and ADR 0001 D6 must say the same in one sentence; (2) add the cheap invariant 'a replacement must not contain its source span text' (kills the one-char-edit and echo cases); (3) re-add DigestPrivacySuite's 'digest independent of offsets' assertion (two checked values differing only in map); (4) ADR note: a future codec decoder cannot re-run checked (source text is not stored) and will need a private[embed] trusted decode path — record it now as a designed bypass. Follow-up, not this commit: checked consumes detector evidence so trust sits in the detector, not any caller — this becomes the first item of your W3 bead (note added there). Nit for later: ScalaCheck generators for PrivacySuite. Reserve, transplant, apply (1)–(4), post the mainline SHA + 3-platform embed-core evidence; I ack; commit; then release privacy.scala so claude-storymodel4s-m1 can start P0-2.
